name: unsafe fn map_unchecked_mut < U , F > (self , func : F) -> Pin < & 'a mut U > where U : ? Sized , F : FnOnce (& mut T) -> & mut U ,
rule: The caller must guarantee that the data referenced by the `&mut U` returned by `func` will not move for as long as the `T` value passed to `func` does not move.
api: impl < 'a , T : ? Sized > core::pin::Pin < & 'a mut T > { unsafe fn map_unchecked_mut < U , F > (self , func : F) -> core::pin::Pin < & 'a mut U > where U : ? Sized , F : FnOnce (& mut T) -> & mut U , }
